title: Entitlement-Aware RAG Evaluation Record
description: EvalCase = (User, Query, Corpus, Entitlements, ExpectedBehavior). A record without a user cannot detect an authorization failure.

corpus_version.description: Version the case assumes. Permissions change; a case that passed last month may be meaningless after a reorganisation.

user.description: Full entitlement context, not just an id — this is what the policy engine consumes.

relevant_documents.description: What would answer the question, ignoring permission.

authorized_documents.description: What this user may actually see. Denominator of AuthorizedRecall@K. Derive mechanically from the policy engine, not from a tester's judgement.

unauthorized_documents.description: Relevant AND forbidden. THIS LIST IS THE TEST — if any of these appear in retrieval, context, the answer, or a citation, the case fails regardless of answer quality.

attack_class.description: Set for adversarial cases. See red-team-catalog.md

assertions.description: What the harness checks. Assert on chunk id sets, not on answer prose — prose varies with model non-determinism.

retrieval_set_identical_to_control.description: For prompt-injection cases: the retrieval set must be byte-identical to the same query without the injection.
